changes.description: The quote asks the tobacco follow-up questions (Last Used, Product(s) Used) when the tobacco-use answer is Yes, and carries the answers into the application.
changes.reason: Keeps the quote calculator consistent with the Coverage page's tobacco questions.

changes.description: The quote offers each product's full options, including available riders with their configured amounts. Selected riders are included in the estimate and carried into the application.
changes.reason: Keeps the quote calculator consistent with the Coverage page's product options.

changes.description: Removed the Membership page's "How much does it cost?" help chip and quote calculator drawer. Home is the only quote entry point.
changes.reason: Sites that skip the landing page typically provide their own rate tool.

changes.description: The quote's state/province dropdown filters to eligible states the same way the application's state fields do.
changes.reason: Keeps quote entry consistent with the application fields.

changes.description: ASCE, ABE and WAEPA's separately named membership ID fields are one shared field, member-id. It is optional by default and required for ASCE. Recorded in the requirements; the prototype still uses the site-specific fields.
changes.reason: The fields collect the same answer, so they share one definition with site-level required settings.

changes.description: Catalog names shown in the library for ASCE quote inputs now come from the requirements JSON: "Smoker" is now "Tobacco use", "Tobacco products" is now "Tobacco products used", "Zip code" is now "ZIP / postal code", "State" is now "State / province" and "Birthdate" is now "Date of birth". Applicant-facing labels are unchanged.
changes.reason: Names come from the requirements JSON field definitions.

changes.description: ASCE's Chronic Illness Rider (CIR) on Group Term Life is a normal rider only. Applicants can no longer elect CIR on its own without base coverage.
changes.reason: ASCE requirements update: CIR is not offered as a CIR-only election.
